title: Kortix manifest (kortix_version 3)
description: kortix.yaml, schema version 3. The project registers skills, tools, commands and extensions; each agent is one block of behavior (prompt, model, permission) and enables registered things by name. No harness config folder is read. Unknown keys are errors.

skills.description: Skills: name → repository folder that holds SKILL.md, named after the skill. Kortix skills (kortix-*) are always registered.

tools.description: Tools: name → repository .ts/.js module. Kortix tools are always registered; a project tool with a Kortix tool name replaces it.

commands.description: Slash commands: name → { description, prompt | prompt_file }. $ARGUMENTS, $1, $2 … take the arguments.

extensions.description: Extensions: name → one implementation per harness. opencode: a repository plugin module. pi: an exact npm pin or a repository path.

permission.description: Tool policy. Omitted: allow. `skill` and `task` belong to `skills` and `subagents`.

prompt_file.description: Repository path of a Markdown file that holds the system prompt.

enabled.description: false: no session can start with this agent. Default true.

codemode.description: pi codemode tool: on (default), only, off.

tools.description: Tools this agent may use: harness, Kortix and registered tools. all (default), none, a list, or { exclude: [...] }.

skills.description: Registered and Kortix skills this agent may load. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.

subagents.description: Declared subagents this agent may start. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.

commands.description: Registered slash commands this agent runs. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.

extensions.description: Registered extensions a session of this agent loads. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.

connectors.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

connectors_required.description: Connector slugs that must resolve before the session starts.

secrets.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

apps.description: Kortix Apps (by App slug) this agent may open when the App is restricted or private. Deny by default.

kortix_permissions.description: Kortix permissions: the project.* IAM actions this agent may exercise, or "all" / "none".

workspace.description: What new sessions of this agent get in /workspace.

project_repository.description: Check out the project repository and allow repository access. Defaults to false: an agent that reads or changes the repository sets true.

network_egress.description: Non-enforcing declaration. Outbound network access remains unrestricted until provider gateway isolation ships.
